snippet.title: Nostalgia in Edinburgh ✨ Scottish Highlands Day Trip (Fort Augustus, Glencoe)
snippet.description:
I was recently in Edinburgh, Scotland for my sister's graduation. I haven't vlogged much while in Scotland (even though I lived there for many years) and this trip I decided to pick up my camera and change that! I hope you enjoy a mini peek into my trip! 

At the start of the video you can see a bit of the "new" terminal at the Helsinki-Vantaa airport. The design is really nice and is similar to the library Oodi's design in Helsinki. The trees that you see in the terminal (downstairs) is where everyone that comes into Helsinki will leave the airport from! 

It was also my sister's first trip to the Highland (can you believe she lived in Edinburgh for 4 years and never went?!). So I was excited for us to get the chance to go together during her "grad trip" .

Next video will focus more on Edinburgh, so look forward to that! 💙

snippet.title: Mini Day Trip To Helsinki | KatChats
snippet.description:
Before Taeho moved back to Korea this summer, we decided to take a mini day trip to Helsinki. For fun I took some video clips and played around on my video editor kinda testing different features xD

Places visited:
✩ Thai Orchid Villa Kamppi (Thai restaurant in the shopping mall Kamppi - even Taeho approved of the food and he lived in Thailand for 9 years! They've moved location recently and it's become a bit fancier than before though)
✩ Helsinki Central Library Oodi - the new library in Helsinki that opened in late 2018
✩ Töölönlahti - We stopped at a little cafe called "Sinisen Huvilan Kahvila" = Blue Villa's Cafe for some coffee and ice cream. Töölönlahti itself is a bay that has nice paths you can walk around. When I used to be in cheerleading we would at the end of our summer training run the whole bay area (it's a circular path) xD
✩ Suomenlinna - The sea fortress right off the Helsinki coast (you can see it from the kauppatori) and you just take the ferry from the main market square - it's under the HSL public transport system so you can just use the HSL app to buy a local ticket that costs 2.80€ (I think it's called zone AB now) to board the ferry
✩ Helsingin Tuomiokirkko (Helsinki Cathedral) - The famous white church in the center of Helsinki (Finnish Evangelical Lutheran Cathedral)

snippet.title: Singapore Beach Day (Sentosa Island) | KatChats
snippet.description:
Join me on my day trip to Sentosa Island in Singapore. This island (only 5 MRT stops from NUS!!) has three FREE public beaches: Tanjong beach, Siloso beach and Palawan beach (where the suspension bridge is located that links to the mini island). 

Some may have heard that the beaches in Singapore aren't that great, but believe me - for a Finn they are more than fine LOL The water is warm, the sand is clean and there are plenty of palm trees. Granted, the view is of barges and you kinda sit in the water and think how clean can this water actually be, but I didn't get any nasty diseases or get dirty from any weird oil etc.

snippet.title: Nostalgia in Edinburgh ✨ Scottish Highlands Day Trip (Fort Augustus, Glencoe)
snippet.description:
I was recently in Edinburgh, Scotland for my sister's graduation. I haven't vlogged much while in Scotland (even though I lived there for many years) and this trip I decided to pick up my camera and change that! I hope you enjoy a mini peek into my trip! 

At the start of the video you can see a bit of the "new" terminal at the Helsinki-Vantaa airport. The design is really nice and is similar to the library Oodi's design in Helsinki. The trees that you see in the terminal (downstairs) is where everyone that comes into Helsinki will leave the airport from! 

It was also my sister's first trip to the Highland (can you believe she lived in Edinburgh for 4 years and never went?!). So I was excited for us to get the chance to go together during her "grad trip" .

Next video will focus more on Edinburgh, so look forward to that! 💙

snippet.title: Mini Day Trip To Helsinki | KatChats
snippet.description:
Before Taeho moved back to Korea this summer, we decided to take a mini day trip to Helsinki. For fun I took some video clips and played around on my video editor kinda testing different features xD

Places visited:
✩ Thai Orchid Villa Kamppi (Thai restaurant in the shopping mall Kamppi - even Taeho approved of the food and he lived in Thailand for 9 years! They've moved location recently and it's become a bit fancier than before though)
✩ Helsinki Central Library Oodi - the new library in Helsinki that opened in late 2018
✩ Töölönlahti - We stopped at a little cafe called "Sinisen Huvilan Kahvila" = Blue Villa's Cafe for some coffee and ice cream. Töölönlahti itself is a bay that has nice paths you can walk around. When I used to be in cheerleading we would at the end of our summer training run the whole bay area (it's a circular path) xD
✩ Suomenlinna - The sea fortress right off the Helsinki coast (you can see it from the kauppatori) and you just take the ferry from the main market square - it's under the HSL public transport system so you can just use the HSL app to buy a local ticket that costs 2.80€ (I think it's called zone AB now) to board the ferry
✩ Helsingin Tuomiokirkko (Helsinki Cathedral) - The famous white church in the center of Helsinki (Finnish Evangelical Lutheran Cathedral)

en.description:

✩ Helsinki Central Library Oodi - the new library in Helsinki that opened in late 2018
✩ Töölönlahti - We stopped at a little cafe called "Sinisen Huvilan Kahvila" = Blue Villa's Cafe for some coffee and ice cream. Töölönlahti itself is a bay that has nice paths you can walk around. snippet.title: Hometown Visit: Trip to Kuopio & Koli ☆ Finnish Road Trip 🇫🇮
snippet.description:
A couple weeks back I went on a mini road trip in Finland. First, we headed to Pohjois-Savo for a visit to Kuopio. We went up the Puijo Tower (Puijon Torni), walked around the market place (with the cheeky "muailman napa") and went on an inland cruise. We then took a day trip to the Koli National Park for some hiking! To end the trip we stayed at a summer cabin. That video is in Finnish with dual Eng/Fin subs and can be found linked here on my other channel: 
╰ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Afjy4MnJdOo

snippet.title: Why is Finland the HAPPIEST country again for the 3rd time?! (2020)
snippet.description:
Why is Finland such a happy place? According to the World Happiness Report (2020), Finland is the happiest country in the world for the third year in a row. Helsinki was also listed as the happiest city! So what makes Finns so happy?
In this video I delve into some of the re-occurring themes I've seen that keep popping up. I also interviewed a few of my Finnish friends and relatives to see what their thoughts on this question are!

snippet.title: Tips for mild SAD during Finnish winters (Seasonal Affective Disorder) | KatChats
snippet.description:
Finnish winters are known to be long, dark and cold. So it's not surprising that many of us may experience some mild forms of seasonal affective disorder, especially when moving to Finland for the first time. 

In this video I talk about some of the tips that I've notice have helped me and relay some tips my Instagram followers have told me helps them! :) 

If you have any extra tips that have helped you that wasn't covered please do leave them in the comments below! 

Please do remember, if you are really struggling a lot with SAD to contact a professional, as they can help you much more than I ever could!

snippet.title: Differences I Noticed When Moving Back to Finland | Reverse Culture Shock?
snippet.description:
Okay, I'm not sure this is strictly a "reverse culture shock" list, BUT I thought it would be fun to go over my experience moving back to Finland after being away for four years & list some of the most prominent things I noticed that were different/took me some time to adjust to. 
So maybe this is more of a differences I noticed when moving back to Finland? I didn't know how to title this so it is what it is xD

P.S. I miss the bagpipes (yes, I could sometimes hear them out my window)

snippet.title: Becoming a Finnish Model for a Day | Mini Helsinki Guide
snippet.description:
Two weekends ago I met up with Kris - a British photographer (now living in Finland) - and we toured around the center of Helsinki experimenting with different photography techniques. Mainly we tried out some hyperlapse style shoots and he took a couple portrait pictures of me too :) 

Where to find Kris: 
● Instagram
╰  https://www.instagram.com/kris_k_photos/
● Business website: 
╰ https://kriskphotos.com/

Places visited:
● Tuomiokirkko 
● Vanha Kauppahalli
● Allas Sea Pool / Helsinki SkyWheel
● Hotel Katajanokka
● Rautatieasema

snippet.title: TOKYO: My First Time in Japan (VLOG) | KatChats
snippet.description:
Here it is, only a year late LOL! Join me on a recap of my first ever visit to Japan: TOKYO! 

I was only in Tokyo for about 5 days (during my reading week in November on my exchange semester in Singapore), and coming from having been in Singapore for several months it was quite the shock to how "cold" it was! Pardon my outfits where I look like I'm in the arctic when really it was only about 10C LOL! All the Japanese people are so stylish I literally looked like a potato in the midst of them, luckily the people I was with were only mildly embarrassed to be associated with me.... :P

Places mentioned: 

Tokyo Disneyland
Asakusa Temple
Akihabara
Shibuya Crossing
Hachiko Dog Statue
Meiji Shrine
Yoyogi Park

en.title: TOKYO: My First Time in Japan (VLOG) | KatChats
en.description:
Here it is, only a year late LOL! Join me on a recap of my first ever visit to Japan: TOKYO! 

I was only in Tokyo for about 5 days (during my reading week in November on my exchange semester in Singapore), and coming from having been in Singapore for several months it was quite the shock to how "cold" it was! Pardon my outfits where I look like I'm in the arctic when really it was only about 10C LOL! All the Japanese people are so stylish I literally looked like a potato in the midst of them, luckily the people I was with were only mildly embarrassed to be associated with me.... :P

Tokyo Disneyland
Asakusa Temple
Akihabara

Hachiko Dog Statue
Meiji Shrine

snippet.title: Singapore Beach Day (Sentosa Island) | KatChats
snippet.description:
Join me on my day trip to Sentosa Island in Singapore. This island (only 5 MRT stops from NUS!!) has three FREE public beaches: Tanjong beach, Siloso beach and Palawan beach (where the suspension bridge is located that links to the mini island). 

Some may have heard that the beaches in Singapore aren't that great, but believe me - for a Finn they are more than fine LOL The water is warm, the sand is clean and there are plenty of palm trees. Granted, the view is of barges and you kinda sit in the water and think how clean can this water actually be, but I didn't get any nasty diseases or get dirty from any weird oil etc.

en.title: Singapore Beach Day (Sentosa Island) | KatChats
en.description:
Join me on my day trip to Sentosa Island in Singapore. This island (only 5 MRT stops from NUS!!) has three FREE public beaches: Tanjong beach, Siloso beach and Palawan beach (where the suspension bridge is located that links to the mini island). 

Some may have heard that the beaches in Singapore aren't that great, but believe me - for a Finn they are more than fine LOL The water is warm, the sand is clean and there are plenty of palm trees. Granted, the view is of barges and you kinda sit in the water and think how clean can this water actually be, but I didn't get any nasty diseases or get dirty from any weird oil etc.
